svg.text: Colorblind + grayscale sims (Machado 2009, full severity; gray = Rec.601 luma). Swatches: Ember · Legendary · UI warn · telegraph | Void · Epic · button | Frost · Rare
Numbers are ΔE00 under each sim. Grayscale Ember vs Void stays close in every option, so the shape pip (flame / ring) stays required (glow spec Q2).
